title: Vector model compression acceptance and cosine-drift validation workflow
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Define and implement an acceptance and CI validation workflow for compressed embedding model variants (INT8 and FP16/FP8 candidates) that focuses on preserving similarity search quality. Deliverables: a calibration playbook, an automated similarity-drift test suite, and a runbook with thresholds and remediation actions.
background: We routinely produce quantized variants of production embedding models to reduce cost. Prior tickets concentrated on calibration runs and offline audits, but we lack a standardized acceptance gate and automated drift checks integrated into CI and the Console. Recent PRs showed occasional cosine similarity shifts for tail queries after INT8 tuning; this ticket consolidates hardening work into a repeatable workflow.
proposal: Create a three-part pipeline: 1) offline calibration artifacts and profile metadata generation for each quantization pass; 2) an automated validation suite that runs a golden prompt set and statistical tests (bootstrap on cosine distributions, per-query percentile checks, and recall@k on a fixed index); 3) a short-circuit gate in CI that blocks merge if drift exceeds configured tolerances. Provide clear remediation steps (recalibrate, fallback to FP16, or narrow quantization block).
calibration_plan:
- Collect per-layer activation histograms and post-quantization scales from representative batch runs.
- Produce a compact quant profile metadata file containing: model hash, tokenizer hash, calibration dataset id, dynamic range summary, and recommended per-op clip points.
- Run 3 calibration sweeps: 1) latency-first INT8, 2) accuracy-first INT8 (more samples), 3) FP16 baseline for comparison.
- Store artifacts in artifact registry under quant-profiles/<model>/<run-id>.
validation_suite:
- Golden dataset: 6k labeled similarity pairs drawn from production query logs (anonymized) + synthetic hard negatives.
- Tests executed: 1) per-vector cosine median shift (target < 0.01 absolute), 2) top-10 recall delta (target < 0.8% relative), 3) per-query worst-case drop rate (no more than 0.5% queries with similarity drop > 0.08), 4) distributional KS test on cosine scores, 5) quantile-drift alert for streaming telemetry.
- CI integration: run on PRs that touch quant codepaths and nightly runs for each promoted profile.
metrics:
- cosine_median_shift: median(cosine_fp_baseline - cosine_quant)
- recall10_delta_pct: 100*(recall10_quant - recall10_baseline)/recall10_baseline
- worstcase_query_drop_rate: percent of queries with drop > 0.08
- ks_pvalue: p-value of KS test comparing cosine distributions
- telemetry_quantiles: 1st/10th/50th/90th/99th cosine quantiles streamed to Console
experiment_log: 2026-02-21: ran initial INT8 sweep on sbert-base-4096 with 10k calibration samples. Observed median cosine shift 0.012 and recall10_delta_pct -1.2%. Baseline FP16 run median shift ~0.0004.
2026-02-25: adjusted per-op clip points using percentile(99.95) sampling; median shift improved to 0.006, recall loss -0.6%. Increased calibration sample diversity reduced tail failures.
2026-03-03: introduced per-query weighted test (weight by query frequency). High-frequency queries showed negligible drift; rare queries concentrated most drop events.
2026-03-09: validated nightly CI harness integration; synthetic hard-negative injection enabled. One PR blocked due to worstcase_query_drop_rate=0.9% (threshold 0.5%).
review_feedback:
- PM (Jordan Meyers): prefer stricter recall10_delta_pct threshold for customer-facing indexes.
- Research (Dr. Elena Ruiz): add a per-layer sensitivity heatmap to prioritize re-quantization.
- Design (Sam Lee): surface the golden-dataset coverage metric in the Console so teams can decide rollouts.
open_questions:
- Should we allow different thresholds for internal vs customer indexes?
- Is bootstrap sampling in CI cost-effective for large models?
- What cadence for automatic recalibration (weekly, on deployment, or threshold-triggered)?
next_steps:
- Finalize acceptance thresholds with PM and Research (target meeting 2026-03-15).
- Wire the validation suite into PR gating for quant-related repos.
- Implement streaming quantile collector and Console visualization.
- Add automated rollback policy: if promoted profile fails nightly drift, auto-fallback to previous profile and page on-call.
